title: Full raw integration-event bodies (buyer name, identity GUID) are written to span tags and logs
owner_hint: top committer: iem365-michael (1 of 1 recent commit); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: Line 161 tags every consumed body and line 172 logs it on failure; events carry BuyerName and BuyerIdentityGuid. The diff replaces the body tag with the byte size, removes the body from the warning log, and stops embedding it in the fake-exception message, while leaving decode and dispatch unchanged.
variants_checked: ProcessEvent already logs only the event name; DeserializeMessage does not log; the remaining body sinks were the tag, the exception text and the warning.
bypass_considered: Exception text still flows into span exception tags, but the self-generated exception no longer contains the body; a JsonException leaks position, not content.
test_note: No suitable test project exists for EventBusRabbitMQ; suggested a broker-free unit test asserting no message tag and size metadata.
review_reason: All three body sinks in OnMessageReceived are replaced with non-identifying metadata while decode, dispatch, and the fake-exception trigger are unchanged. No new input surface and no validation weakened.
